user.title: Simple Heating Manager
user.description: Configure your boiler switches and notification service.

data_description.cv_switch_1: Primary switch that controls the boiler.

data_description.name: A unique name for this room.
data_description.trv_entity: The climate entity of the TRV to control.
data_description.temp_sensor: External temperature sensor to push to the TRV.
data_description.window_sensors: Binary sensors that detect open windows.
data_description.sensor_mode_entity: Select entity to switch TRV between internal/external sensor.
data_description.room_switch: Optional switch to turn on when room needs heat (e.g. floor heating pump).
data_description.check_interval: How often to check and update (in seconds).
